cards.name: Academy
cards.text: You may perform one THINKER action after any turn during which you performed at least one CRAFTSMAN action.

cards.name: Amphitheatre
cards.text: Upon completion, you may perform one CRAFTSMAN action for each influence.

cards.name: Aqueduct
cards.text:
When performing PATRON action, you may take one additional client from your hand.
Maximum clientele x2

cards.name: Archway
cards.text: When performing ARCHITECT action, you may take a material from the pool instead of from your stockpile.

cards.name: Atrium
cards.text: When performing MERCHANT action, you may take a card from the deck instead of your stockpile. (don't look at it)

cards.name: Bar
cards.text: When performing PATRON action, you may take one additional client from the deck.

cards.name: Basilica
cards.text: When performing MERCHANT action, you may move one additional card from your hand to your vault.

cards.name: Bath
cards.text: When performing PATRON action, each client you hire may perform its action once as it enters your clientele.

cards.name: Bridge
cards.text: When performing LEGIONARY action, you may demand materials from all players. You may additionally take one material from each opponent's stockpile. Ignore Palisades.

cards.name: Catacomb
cards.text: Upon completion, the game ends immediately. Score as usual.

cards.name: Circus Maximus
cards.text: Each of your clients may perform its action twice when you lead or follow its role.

cards.name: Dock
cards.text: When performing LABORER action, you may take one additional material from your hand.

cards.name: Foundry
cards.text: Upon completion, you may perform one LABORER action for each influence.

cards.name: Fountain
cards.text: You may perform CRAFTSMAN actions with cards from the deck instead of from your hand. You may also keep the card and skip the action.

cards.name: Garden
cards.text: Upon completion, you may perform one PATRON action for each influence.

cards.name: Gate
cards.text: MARBLE structures provide their functions as soon as you lay their foundations.

cards.name: Insula
cards.text: Maximum clientele +2

cards.name: Latrine
cards.text: Before performing THINKER action, you may discard one card to pool.

cards.name: Ludus Magnus
cards.text: Each MERCHANT client in your clientele counts as any role.

cards.name: Market
cards.text: Maximum vault +2

cards.name: Palace
cards.text: You may play multiple cards of the same role to perform additional actions.

cards.name: Palisade
cards.text: Immune to LEGIONARY

cards.name: Prison
cards.text: Upon completion, you may exchange the prison's site (and thus influence) for an opponent's completed structure.

cards.name: Road
cards.text: You may use any materials towards the completion of STONE structures.

cards.name: School
cards.text: Upon completion, you may perform one THINKER action for each influence.

cards.name: Scriptorium
cards.text: You may complete any structure by adding one MARBLE material to it, no matter its real cost.

cards.name: Sewer
cards.text: You may place orders cards you used to lead or follow into your stockpile at the end of turn.

cards.name: Shrine
cards.text: Hand refill size +2

cards.name: Stairway
cards.text: When performing ARCHITECT action, you may additionally add a material to opponent's completed STRUCTURE to make its function available to all players.

cards.name: Statue
cards.text:
+3 VP.
You may place the statue on any site.

cards.name: Storeroom
cards.text: Each client in your clientele counts as LABORER.

cards.name: Temple
cards.text: Hand refill size +4

cards.name: Tower
cards.text:
You may use RUBBLE in any structure.
You may lay foundations onto any out of town site at no extra cost.

cards.name: Villa
cards.text: If you use the ARCHITECT to put one stone into the construction of the villa, it is completed immediately.

cards.name: Vomitorium
cards.text: Before performing THINKER action you may discard all your cards to the pool.

cards.name: Wall
cards.text:
Immune to LEGIONARY.
+1 VP for every two materials in your stockpile.

sets.name: Glory to Rome — BGG Expansion Buildings

cards.name: Aerarium
cards.text:
Use highest influence among players at all times except final scoring.
Upon completion, you give this site to the owner of a completed structure to perform its 'upon completion' effect.

cards.name: Bacchanalia
cards.text: Upon Completion, reveal cards from the deck equal to your influence. You may put one into each: your vault, your stockpile, your clientele, as foundation on an in-town site, an incomplete structure as material. Leftovers go to your hand.

cards.name: Castra
cards.text: THINK at end of a round in which you lost at least one card from your hand to a LEGIONARY

cards.name: Castra Praetoria
cards.text:
You may show an incomplete structure to demand with a LEGIONARY
Upon completion, you may put the material from this structure into your clientele.

cards.name: Circus
cards.text: You may play two cards of the same role as a JACK

cards.name: Colosseum
cards.text: When performing a LEGIONARY action, you may additionally take one matching client from each opponent and place it in your vault.

cards.name: Crane
cards.text: You may use any card to lead or follow ARCHITECT.

cards.name: Domus
cards.text: Upon Completion, you may perform one PATRON action.

cards.name: Domus Aurea
cards.text: When performing LEGIONARY action, you may additionally tear down one matching incomplete building with no material of each opponent. Place foundation in your stockpile and site in your influence.

cards.name: Forum
cards.text: You win immediately whenever you have a client of each type in your clientele.

cards.name: Forum Romanum
cards.text: You win immediately whenever you have a client of each role in your clientele and one material of each type in your stockpile.

cards.name: Plebeian Council
cards.text: You win immediately whenever you have more LABORER clients than any other player and there are more LABORER clients than LEGIONARY clients in total.

cards.name: Senate
cards.text: At the end of each turn, you may take into your hand any JACKS played by opponents.

cards.name: Solarium
cards.text: Whenever you complete a structure (including this) using an ARCHITECT, you may move one material from that structure into your stockpile.

cards.name: Tribunal
cards.text: After performing THINKER action you may draw a JACK.

cards.name: Triclinium
cards.text: When leading or following, you may put each client into your vault after it performs its role.

cards.name: Watch Post
cards.text: You may use a CRAFTSMAN action to tear down one of your completed structures. Add its foundation to your hand and its material to your stockpile.

cards.name: Watermill
cards.text: At end of a turn in which you led or followed a LABORER, you may use each of your ARCHITECT client once.
